style.backgroundSystem: one flat plane per screen: a dark umber field #241C15 laid over open-grain walnut board #4A3527 for the hero, macro, scene and gallery screens, alternating with a wheat-gold paper band #E8D5A2 carrying a wavy die-cut lower edge for the icon, spec and closing screens, and an off-white card field #F7F2E8 for the packshot, comparison and section-detail screens; no gradient, no marble, no pure seamless studio sweep, no landscape scenery
style.direction: warm umber low-key dried-goods detail-page commerce
style.iconSystem: hollow thin-line pictograms at one uniform stroke weight, three per screen maximum, drawn in brick-red #9E2F22 on the wheat-gold band #E8D5A2 and in wheat-gold #E8D5A2 on the dark umber field #241C15, each icon centred above its own empty dotted caption circle; no 3D icons, no gradient fills, no flames, crosses, shields or body diagrams
style.lightingSystem: warm single-side soft key between 3000K and 4000K, deep matte falloff on the dark screens and a broad bounce fill on the paper screens, low contrast with fibrous dry highlights only, one defined contact shadow that always grounds the product, never a hard flash, never a flat shadowless beauty look, never a glossy plastic sheen
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm umber low-key dried-goods ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of a dark umber field #241C15, a wheat-gold paper band #E8D5A2, an off-white card field #F7F2E8 and one brick-red accent #9E2F22; warm tone throughout; warm single-side soft key between 3000K and 4000K with deep matte falloff on dark screens and a broad bounce fill on paper screens, fibrous matte highlights only, one defined contact shadow that always grounds the product; one flat plane per screen, a wavy die-cut edge where the paper band meets the field below, no gradient, no marble, no pure seamless studio white, no scenery; one modern geometric sans-serif for headline and label placeholders only, hollow thin-line pictograms at one uniform stroke weight inside empty dotted caption circles, three per screen maximum; dried pieces read matte, brittle and fibrous, cooked pieces read plump in clear amber liquor, never glossy, never plastic; stable slight 3/4 20-degree product attitude and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts or brush calligraphy, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no mixed fonts or brush calligraphy
no pure white seamless studio sweep, no marble, no gradient field
no glossy plastic sheen or wet look on the dried pieces
no visible brand mark, QR code, membership badge or contact detail
no printed origin name, grade, weight, count, content figure, test result or efficacy wording
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 20-degree attitude and constant scale for the dish and pieces across the set; dried pieces always read matte, brittle and fibrous with a dry textured cap and a pale dry stem, cooked pieces read plump with real relief in clear amber liquor; every item grounded by a contact shadow; nothing bleached, glossy, wet-looking or recoloured; text overlays never cross a piece
style.surfaceSystem: walnut board #4A3527 with visible open grain, folded indigo linen cloth #2B3348, pale glazed ceramic bowl and shallow dish #F3EBDC with a hairline rim, amber cooking liquor #C8912F, wheat-gold paper card #E8D5A2, off-white card board #F7F2E8, dark umber matte board #241C15
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif used only for headline and label placeholders; wheat-gold #E8D5A2 or off-white #F7F2E8 lettering on the dark umber field #241C15, brick-red #9E2F22 or dark umber #241C15 lettering on the paper fields #E8D5A2 and #F7F2E8; headline 28-48pt, one sub-line 16-20pt, label 10-14pt, one weight per screen; every label sits inside an outlined chip or a dotted circle; no calligraphy, no brush script, no serif display, no vertical letter columns
